signal: EliseAI raised a $250M Series E at a $2.2B valuation led by Sapphire Ventures, with property management AI now serving one in six U.S. rental units

email.body1:
Bobby, saw EliseAI close its $250M Series E at a $2.2B valuation, now touching one in six U.S. rental units.

At that scale, the bottleneck is rarely intent data, it is signal-to-action latency: by the time a rep acts, the moment has passed. Our AI SDR turns signals into researched, personalized outreach automatically: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for EliseAI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress around 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Bobby, quick follow-up for EliseAI.

Post-raise, RevOps usually knows where the funnel leaks but cannot get reps to act on signals fast enough, and data hygiene eats the hours that should go to follow-up. That latency is usually the biggest measurable drag on conversion.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Bobby, last bit of proof for EliseAI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how EliseAI's reply rate likely compares to other late-stage startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Bobby, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters right after a raise, and I know scaling ops to match that growth is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your ops motion? I will tailor it to EliseAI either way.
